name: Omich-2
characteristics: Strength: Multi-role: ammunition/equipment delivery, assault group transport, and casualty evacuation in one platform
Limitation: Short endurance (40min) and range (20km) relative to Ukraine's Starlink-relay-extended logistics UGVs
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not disclosed
employment_notes: Represents the practical center of gravity of Russian ground robotics use - moving supplies and wounded through exposed ground rather than combat, mirroring the same logistics-first pattern seen across Ukrainian UGV use
contrast_vs_traditional: Omich-2's logistics, transport, and casualty-evacuation role mirrors NPRK Mul on the Ukrainian side — both sides converging independently on unmanned platforms for the specific job of moving supplies and wounded across the same watched ground that makes manned resupply increasingly costly, per the doctrine.md finding on how densely observed this front actually is.
